isp_header.row_note: odd row (MISO, SCK, RESET) at v = -row_a_offset, even row 2.54 mm further out, in front of the pogo grid

pogo.series: P75 class (1.02 mm barrel, about 16.5 mm long, about 2.6 mm travel)
pogo.tip: B1 spear or LM2 cone for bare 1.0 mm square HASL/ENIG pads
pogo.head_note: B1/LM2 heads must pass the 1.15 mm guide hole; 1.3-1.5 mm heads need the guide drilled out

probe_board.v_max_note: computed: upper jaw tip + tip section length - step_margin
probe_board.copies_note: second unpopulated copy is the lower pin guide under the jaw

clip_kit.note: Seller publishes no drawing. Values are estimates from the Adafruit 5434 datasheet drawing and scaled photos; measure the real jaw and update before ordering boards.

sources.datasheet: Adafruit 5434 C17220-001 datasheet p8 (62.5 mm overall, 6 mm tip) and p13 (P75 pin)
sources.side_photo: Adafruit 5434 side photo, scaled by US quarter (24.26 mm) and 62.5 mm length, agree within ~3%
sources.front_photo: Adafruit 5434 front photo, scaled by 2.54 mm header pitch
sources.listing_photo: AliExpress 1005006153573416 image 6: hinge ~47% of length, two M2 holes across the upper jaw tip

geometry.frame: x from lower jaw tip toward hinge, z up from lower jaw top at the tip

clip_kit.screw: M2x10 pan head + M2 nut (kit screws are 12-16 mm; too long for the 9.2 mm grip)

component_heights_mm.note: datasheet maximum package heights; the ring STEP has no 3D models
